text:
maria: FYI, GCP marketplace partner CloudFleet submitted a new SKU family 'EdgePack-GPU' that needs a separate PO with delivery/incoterms attached — procurement put the opportunity on hold.
ben_salesops: ugh. do we have the vendor invoice + sample PO? procurement wants the delivery terms spelled out.
sonya_procurement: correct — vendor's current portal invoice doesn't include Incoterms or a physical delivery address. we can't map to our ledger until we get a proper shipping/delivery clause or an 'electronic delivery' confirmation. need vendor to accept our standard PO template.
sarah_legal: can you drop the vendor PO pdf here? i'll scan for any export-control or warranty language that would require an MSA amendment.
maria: attaching the vendor's portal link and the PO snippet they posted in the marketplace: ```
LineItem: EdgePack-GPU 8x
Price: 48,000 USD
Delivery: TBD
Notes: 'onsite kit may require local carrier'```
ken_eng: engineering flag — this SKU requires a hardware acceptance test and an on-prem install window. if procurement forces a 'software only' PO we won't be able to bill/provide install hours.
sonya_procurement: thanks — that's exactly why finance is balking. they need to know whether this is a 'delivered' product (needs address & carrier) vs 'digital'.
ben_salesops: can we ask partner to accept our 'marketplace addendum' that maps this SKU to existing catalog SKUs temporarily? would avoid creating a new vendor entity.
maria: partner is saying their legal won't sign a new addendum for a marketplace-only SKU. they're willing to accept standard marketplace terms but won't provide a physical address on the PO.
sarah_legal: if they refuse our addendum we need to redline two places: 1) Delivery terms (add 'electronic delivery accepted for firmware and software components; hardware shipment per carrier T&C') 2) Indemnity/export control clause (CloudFleet mentions dual-use GPUs). i'll prepare a 1-page redline.
procurement-bot: FYI — finance approval workflow paused at step 2 (account mapping). Reference: PO-78942.
sonya_procurement: timeline: vendor needs to send updated PO or accept our redline by EOD Thursday or legal will require a signed MSA amendment before we can proceed.
ben_salesops: quick workaround idea — can we offer a temporary 'service bundle' purchase (servicing + digital license) and schedule hardware separate through professional services? avoids touching marketplace PO flow.
ken_eng: that could work operationally but impacts billing recognition and PSA scheduling. need sign-off from revenue ops.
maria: action items — @sarah_legal will drop redline by EOD; @ben_salesops to propose service-bundle workaround to vendor; @sonya_procurement to update finance with blocker and timeline. I'll triage partner comms and escalate to GCP partner manager if the vendor stalls.
ben_salesops: noted. i'll ping partner manager and loop revenueops.
sarah_legal: uploaded redline snapshot to drive: https://drive.redfleet/edgepack-redline (private). please review.
maria: thanks — everyone, react with :thumbsup: once you read the redline and i'll send to vendor. no replies needed if blocked.
